decisions.reason: The source adds a connector to the integrated-board matrix, while this Requirement describes the separate sensor-board connector hub and its existing ten-connector matrix.
The source does not identify the omitted connector as an interboard signal connector or change any established interboard connector type, pinout, or reference.
The newly included sensor-related JST connector does not alter the panel power-button connector, location, signal, or behavior.
The source does not identify the omitted connector as J_RESET or change the panel reset interface.
The source does not associate the omitted connector with J_LED_CHG or change any charge-status output requirement.
Adding an unspecified JST connector does not change the SPS30 SEL-to-ground connection or its I2C operating mode.
The source does not identify the added connector as the PIR interface, and the existing PIR-connector requirement remains valid unchanged.
The source adds an unspecified connector to the sensor matrix but does not change the e-paper backlight supply, switching, PWM, or component requirements.
The source does not identify the omitted connector as a panel button or switch connector and does not alter their GPIO assignments or mounting.
Including another JST connector does not change the sensors' logic voltages, the omission of level-shifter footprints, or the external-adapter policy.
The source does not associate the omitted sensor connector with the buzzer or change its type, package, voltage, or approved part policy.
The source does not identify the omitted connector as J_TOUCH or J_TOUCH2 and does not change either touch input or GPIO assignment.
